items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.information: Русский Summer in Bishkek 2024 - это открытый чемпионат по скоростной сборке головоломок в городе Бишкек. Базовый регистрационный взнос за 1 дисциплину составляет 200 сом. За 2 или более дисциплин взнос составляет 700 сом. Данные соревнования организованы при поддержки команды QBERS. 10 процетов от всех собранных средств будут отправлены в международную благотворительную организацию "Интеракт" Кыргызча Summer in Bishkek 2024 — Бишкек шаарында өтүүчү пазлдарды жогорку ылдамдыкта чогултуу боюнча ачык чемпионат. 1 дисциплинага негизги каттоо төлөмү 200 сом. 2 же андан көп дисциплиналар үчүн төлөм 700 сомду түзөт. Бул мелдештер QBERS командасынын колдоосу менен уюштурулууда. Бардык чогултулган каражаттардын 10 пайызы "Интеракт" эл аралык кайрымдуулук уюмуна жөнөтүлөт English Summer in Bishkek 2024 is an open championship in high-speed puzzle assembly in the city of Bishkek. The basic registration fee for 1 discipline is 200 soms. For 2 or more disciplines the fee is 700 soms. These competitions are organized with the support of the QBERS team. 10 percent of all funds raised will be sent to the international charity organization "Interact"

items.information: ## Information [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024! This competition has a full array of blindfolded events, with Clock and 5x5 to mix things up. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see payment details below. **Important** - if we do not have enough competitors to hold 3x3 Blindfolded Round 2, we will adjust the schedule to have 2 Rounds of 5x5 instead. **PLEASE NOTE** This competition does NOT have 3x3 or other popular events like 2x2 or Pyraminx. If you are a newcomer, please do not register unless you are able to solve cubes Blindfolded or would like to participate in the 5x5 or Clock events. ## SPECTATORS Spectators are only allowed as companions to competitors. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with **volunteering** during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If any competitor or competitor's guests are willing to help judge with the blindfolded events, especially Multiple Blindfolded, please let us know. If you are able to assist with judging the longer events (4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and Multiple Blindfolded), we will reward you with a free coffee, chocolate, or other small gift :) #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you are able to assist in any way and want to get involved, please get in touch [here](https://cubingza.org/contact)!
